Carry-select adder cell usage in auto mode depends on whether the tool determines there is a QoR benefit.

The -cond_sum_adder parameter controls the use of conditional-sum adder architectures.
The -sklansky_adder parameter controls the use of Sklansky parallel-prefix adder architectures.
The Sklansky parallel-prefix adder architecture usually results in QoR degradation.
The -brent_kung_adder parameter controls whether Brent-Kung parallel-prefix adder architectures are used.
Brent-Kung parallel-prefix adder architectures usually degrade QoR.
The -bounded_fanout_adder parameter controls whether bounded fanout adder architectures are used.
Bounded fanout adder architectures correspond to Kogge-Stone parallel-prefix architectures.
The -mux_based parameter enables the use of MUX-based architectures by datapath generators when set to auto or true.
When set to auto, the -mux_based parameter is used only if the tool determines there is a QoR benefit.
The -inv_adder_cell parameter enables the use of full adder cells with inverted carry-in or carry-out in the target library when set to auto or true.
When set to auto, the -inv_adder_cell parameter is used only if the tool determines there is a QoR benefit.
The -sop2pos_transformation parameter enables SOP to POS transformation in datapath blocks when set to true or auto.
The -sop2pos_transformation parameter can improve design area through SOP to POS optimization.
The -sop2pos_transformation parameter can degrade delay, indicating a timing cost.
SOP to POS transformation can improve design area in datapath blocks.
SOP to POS transformation can come at the cost of delay, degrading timing.
When -sop2pos_transformation is set to auto, use of SOP to POS transformation depends on whether the tool determines a QoR benefit.
The -tp_opt_tree parameter enables carry-save adder tree optimization for low-power optimization based on transition probabilities.
The -tp_opt_tree parameter reduces internal switching activity and improves dynamic power in SOP implementations when input transition probabilities are non-uniform.
Transition-probability-based carry-save adder tree optimization reduces internal switching activity and improves dynamic power.
The optimization is applied when dynamic power is being optimized.
The -tp_oper_sel parameter controls transition-probability-based selection or ordering of multiplier input operands for low power.
Transition-probability-based multiplier operand selection can reduce internal switching activity and thereby improve dynamic power.
When -tp_oper_sel is set to auto, the feature is used only if the tool determines a QoR benefit.
The feature is applied when dynamic power is being optimized.
The option affects only multipliers that use booth encoding.
The -smart_compare option enables smart ordering of comparator inputs.
Smart comparator input ordering improves timing by eliminating an output inverter and shortening the critical path when beneficial.
When set to auto or true, -smart_compare is applied only if the tool determines a QoR benefit.
Setting -smart_compare to false disables smart comparator input ordering.
The set_dp_smartgen_options command controls smart generation strategies used in datapath synthesis.
Smart generation strategies are automatically chosen based on the given design constraints, including timing-related goals.
